name: A Story Told By The Stars
source:
Set in a near, highly militarized future, two guys look at the stars wondering about their past. 

Even though they started with the wrong foot, their lives seems to be intertwined by fate.

Watch how the story of Mark and Ansel develop creating new memories with them through the stars.

[From [url=https://aurum-lingua-games.itch.io/a-story-told-by-the-stars]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
故事发生在一个高度军事化的未来，两个人看着星星，对自己的过去感到好奇。

尽管他们一开始就错了，但他们的人生却似乎被命运交织在一起。

观看马克和安塞尔的故事如何发展，通过星星与他们一起创造新的回忆。

[来自[url=https://aurum-lingua-games.itch.io/a-story-told-by-the-stars]Itch.io[/url]]
